title: Carrier-normalized open-extension unit generation
statement: For the actual system categories of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], let O be normalized OpenSystems data with restriction evaluations equal to identity on sections. Transport its ordinary system unit along the proved carrier equality of open restriction. For an open system M and a level n, two module-sheaf maps from the n-th evaluation of O.extension(M) to an arbitrary B_n-module sheaf agree whenever they agree on every such transported unit section over each V→U. Continuous module pushforward, scalar restriction and system evaluation preserve the actual section carriers and restriction functions, with explicitly proved transports; these ancillary identities supply the criterion without changing any coefficient object.

source.place: Tags 03DI--03DJ, extension-by-zero adjunction; Mathlib SheafOfModules.pushforward and Adjunction.homEquiv_unit.

proof.text: For a continuous module pushforward, its section carrier and section functions are those of the original presheaf at the image object. Prove these carrier equalities before specializing the ring sheaves. Transport functions with casts, which preserve equality, composition, heterogeneous values, and injectivity. Apply this also to evaluation and scalar restriction.

Transport the system adjunction unit through actual open restriction. Naturality follows from naturality of that unit and the proved pushforward restriction formula. Evaluate OpenSystems.unit_evaluation on a slice section; the restriction evaluation is identity on sections, so extension evaluation sends the transported system unit to the ordinary localized unit.

Precompose both proposed maps by inverse extension evaluation. Apply the injective Hom equivalence of the ordinary extension/restriction adjunction. Its unit formula reduces equality of the transposes to equality on ordinary unit sections. The preceding normalization and cancellation of the extension evaluation isomorphism reduce this to the given equality on transported system units.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03DI--03DJ; the ordinary adjunction unit and actual continuous module pushforward section formulas.
